create_plot_ellipses: create ellipses on a matplotlib axis from Gaussian mixture weights, means, and covariances
create_plot_results: create scatter plot and bar chart of Gaussian mixture estimator weights and data points
create_BayesianGaussianMixture: create a BayesianGaussianMixture model with Dirichlet distribution or Dirichlet process prior
